result.transcript: Show every account that shares a phone with Usman Ghani.

cypher_attempts.query:
MATCH (p:Person) 
WHERE toLower(p.canonical_name) CONTAINS toLower('Usman Ghani')
MATCH (r:Record)-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:HOLDS]->(ownAcc:Account)
MATCH (r)-[:USES_PHONE]->(ph:Phone)
OPTIONAL MATCH (otherRec:Record)-[:USES_PHONE]->(ph)
WHERE otherRec <> r
OPTIONAL MATCH (otherRec)-[:HOLDS]->(localAcc:Account)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ph)-[:SAME_AS]->(fp:Fingerprint)<-[:HAS_FP]-(partnerAcc:Account)
WITH collect(DISTINCT localAcc) + collect(DISTINCT partnerAcc) AS acctList, ownAcc, p, r
UNWIND acctList AS a
WITH a, ownAcc, p, r
WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND (ownAcc IS NULL OR a.iban <> ownAcc.iban)
RETURN a.iban AS iban, a.bank AS bank, a.title_raw AS title_raw,
       p.pid AS pid, r.rid AS rid
LIMIT 200
